The '''Burner deflector shield''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system produced by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Burner shield was an average shield except for its engine power converter, which allowed the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to transfer a portion of the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] shielding power to the engine reserves.
